ونستهديه،: And we seek guidance from Him,
وَحده: And He is One and Unique
تطلع: To look out or over; to appear above.
وَسلم: And Muqattu‘, which is what falls from a man of his Sanad.
اسْتَحْلَفته: I took an oath from him
وَثَّقَهُ: And he has firmly established it.
وأصحها: And the most correct of them
رَحمَه: May Allah have mercy upon him
قَرِيبا-: قَرِيبا- is translated as 'Soon' or 'Near at hand', depending on context.
يستخير: He consults for guidance or seeks divine favor.
بالتسبيح،: By means of glorifying and praising [Allah].
وَيُكَفِّرُ: And he will make him disbelieve
وأقمره،: And He made it (the moon) full.
بِنَحْوِهِ: In a manner similar to it.
الطَّائِي: The one who is inclined towards innovation in religion.
\"فاستغفرنا\": So we sought forgiveness for ourselves
عَيناهُ: We have set our eyes upon him
صبّحكم: Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
اقتراف: The act of committing (a sin or offense)
